last.verdict: Teva raised 2026 sales guidance again as brand drugs grew 33%, but profit guidance barely moved and generics keep shrinking.

takeaways.label: Brand drugs accelerate
takeaways.text: Austedo ($751M, +21%), Ajovy ($269M, +61%) and Uzedy ($85M, +96%) together hit about $1.1B, up 33%. Forecasts for all three were raised again.

takeaways.label: Sales outlook up, profit flat
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue guidance rose to $16.7–17.0B from $16.5–16.85B. Adjusted EPS guidance stayed essentially unchanged at $1.92–2.11, and the top end of operating income and EBITDA ranges was cut.

takeaways.label: Generics a drag
takeaways.text: Total revenue fell 2% to $4.4B as generics sales dropped 16%, mainly from lower sales of the cancer drug generic lenalidomide. Profit margins still improved.

takeaways.label: Balance sheet turns corner
takeaways.text: Moody's and S&P upgraded Teva to investment grade after Fitch. About $4.9B of debt was refinanced; debt is $16.7B, with a goal of reaching 2x leverage by end of 2027.

history.verdict: Stronger brand-drug sales and raised guidance outweighed a profit miss.

reasons.label: Austedo outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 Austedo sales guidance lifted to $2.45–2.6 billion; U.S. sales up 33%.

reasons.label: Revenue guidance raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook raised to $16.5–16.85 billion on Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy.

reasons.label: Miss blamed on deal
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of 2 cents missed; Emalex acquisition cost about 61 cents per share.
